sources.title: Grok2 - Vedic Astrology
sources.snippet: The goal is not to chase fashionable AI claims, but to build useful local systems for Sanskrit corpus work, Jyotiṣa rule modelling, MBFR documents, pure-Hindi generation, code assistance, video/text pipelines, and tabular forecasting such as gold, rainfall, weather, and related numeric models.
